mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_CODE as prodCode, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, REG_DATE as regDate FROM Common_Product ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.PROD_ID as prodId, p.PROD_CODE as prodCode, p.PROD_NAME as name, p.PROD_PRICE as price, h.PREV_PRICE as prevPrice, ((h.PREV_PRICE - p.PROD_PRICE) / h.PREV_PRICE * 100) as dropRate FROM Common_Product p JOIN ( SELECT PROD_ID, PRICE as PREV_PRICE FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID, PRICE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PROD_ID ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC) as rn FROM PRICE_HISTORY ) WHERE rn = 2 ) h ON p.PROD_ID = h.PROD_ID ) WHERE dropRate >= 10 ORDER BY dropRate DESC

SELECT p.PROD_ID as prodId, p.PROD_CODE as prodCode, p.PROD_NAME as name, p.PROD_PRICE as price FROM Common_Product p WHERE p.PROD_PRICE = ( SELECT MIN(PRICE) FROM PRICE_HISTORY WHERE PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID ) ORDER BY p.REG_DATE DESC

SELECT T.DEAL_ID as prodId, T.TITLE as name, T.CURRENT_PRICE as price, T.ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, T.MALL_NAME as mallName, T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE as lastUpdateDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER T WHERE T.CURRENT_PRICE = ( SELECT MIN(PRICE) FROM TB_PRICE_HISTORY H WHERE H.DEAL_ID = T.DEAL_ID ) ORDER BY T.LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC
